title: Model Capacity Frontier: A Development Framework for LLM-Supported Social Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.24168v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly incorporated into agent-based models (ABMs) on the premise that richer, context-sensitive human behavior can improve empirical fidelity. However, LLM-supported ABMs introduce an open-ended design space in which subtle modeling and configuration choices, such as prompt design and environment coupling, can substantially alter outcomes. Developing LLM-supported ABMs to simulate human collective behavior therefore requires navigating configuration sensitivity while identifying the limitations of the current model architecture. In this paper, we introduce the Model Capacity Frontier (MCF), a framework that characterizes the empirical performance attainable by a specified architecture across its admissible configurations. In multi-objective settings, this capacity is represented by an estimated Pareto frontier obtained through systematic configuration exploration. We demonstrate MCF

translated_title: 模型能力边界：一个用于大语言模型支持的社会模拟的开发框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被纳入基于智能体的模型（ABM）中，其前提是更丰富、更具情境敏感性的人类行为能够提升经验保真度。然而，LLM支持的ABM引入了一个开放式的设计空间，其中细微的建模与配置选择，例如提示设计和环境耦合，可能会显著改变模拟结果。因此，开发用于模拟人类集体行为的LLM支持的ABM，需要在应对配置敏感性的同时识别当前模型架构的局限性。在本文中，我们提出了模型能力边界（MCF），这是一个刻画特定架构在其可容许配置范围内所能达到的经验性能的框架。在多目标设置中，这种能力通过系统性配置探索所获得的估计Pareto前沿来表示。我们展示了MCF……
tldr: 本文提出模型能力边界（MCF）框架，通过系统性配置探索并以估计的Pareto前沿来刻画LLM支持的社会模拟中特定架构在其可容许配置范围内所能达到的经验性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Model Capacity Frontier (MCF), a framework that characterizes the empirical performance attainable by a specified architecture across its admissible configurations for LLM-supported social simulation, represented as an estimated Pareto frontier in multi-objective settings.
